title: Isolated live completion evidence audit
spec:
Audit the live-verification work already on pull request https://github.com/RankOneLabs/oakridge/pull/771. This is an isolated verification run of the committed development definition, not new feature implementation. Produce one cohort named slice in repository oakridge. Preserve two run-unique criterion IDs: criterion-lineage for capture provenance and criterion-export for authenticated stored-record readback. Use decision-capture for the decision to preserve the production publisher wire payloads and use authenticated HTTP response bodies. Both criteria must cite decision-capture, and retain the same IDs in the brief and assessment.
The builder must inspect and test the existing live-verification changes, publish actual test counts and any gaps, and publish the existing PR #771 as the pr artifact (branch cohort/live-verification/bc33be). The assessor must assess the existing code and publish factual findings linked to these criteria. Do not edit code, create commits, push or create a new PR, merge anything, reset any database or deploy. Existing failures and absent live credentials are findings, not reasons to invent passing evidence. Keep the analysis/spec/tasks/plan/brief concise; there are no ambiguous requirements to resolve. Plan-wide acceptance_criteria may be ordinary text per the declared schema. The purposes are a real newly produced plan/brief/assessment and production capture; no pre-existing observation fixtures may be used as artifact bodies.
For criterion-lineage, inspect the live source capture launcher and v2 provenance validation. For criterion-export, inspect tenant-scoped question/evidence API routes and direct provider readback. Actual grading is performed after this source run. A capture need not claim a provider grade already occurred. The separately recorded gated-review server invalid-token acceptance is an open upstream issue, not an authorization to change that server.
